recipes.name: Fruit and Cream Cheese Breakfast Pastries
recipes.notes: Source: TheMealDB id 52957. Free for commercial use. https://www.themealdb.com/

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Preheat oven to 400ºF (200ºC), and prepare two cookie sheets with parchment paper. In a bowl, mix cream cheese, sugar, and vanilla until fully combined. Lightly flour the surface and roll out puff pastry on top to flatten. Cut each sheet of puff pastry into 9 equal squares. On the top right and bottom left of the pastry, cut an L shape approximately ½ inch (1 cm) from the edge.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: NOTE: This L shape should reach all the way down and across the square, however both L shapes should not meet at the ends. Your pastry should look like a picture frame with two corners still intact.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Take the upper right corner and fold down towards the inner bottom corner. You will now have a diamond shape.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Place 1 to 2 teaspoons of the cream cheese filling in the middle, then place berries on top.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.instruction: Repeat with the remaining pastry squares and place them onto the parchment covered baking sheet.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.instruction: Bake for 15-20 minutes or until pastry is golden brown and puffed.

recipes.name: Salmon Eggs Eggs Benedict
recipes.notes: Source: TheMealDB id 52962. Free for commercial use. https://www.themealdb.com/

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: First make the Hollandaise sauce. Put the lemon juice and vinegar in a small bowl, add the egg yolks and whisk with a balloon whisk until light and frothy. Place the bowl over a pan of simmering water and whisk until mixture thickens. Gradually add the butter, whisking constantly until thick – if it looks like it might be splitting, then whisk off the heat for a few mins. Season and keep warm.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: To poach the eggs, bring a large pan of water to the boil and add the vinegar. Lower the heat so that the water is simmering gently. Stir the water so you have a slight whirlpool, then slide in the eggs one by one. Cook each for about 4 mins, then remove with a slotted spoon.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Lightly toast and butter the muffins, then put a couple of slices of salmon on each half. Top each with an egg, spoon over some Hollandaise and garnish with chopped chives.
